synopsis: Journey through Middle-earth with a new company of heroes as the War of the Ring unfolds around them. Face the forces of Sauron in turn-based battles, develop your party's abilities and follow a story that crosses paths with familiar places and events from The Lord of the Rings films.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Take the mound for another season of Power Pro baseball. Read each pitch, place your hits and back up your team with sharp fielding as the series' familiar cartoon players bring the diamond to life. This Ketteiban edition revisits Power Pro 9 with a revised version of its baseball action.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Step onto the diamond and put your baseball instincts to work. Challenge the opposition with carefully chosen pitches, turn a well-timed swing into a scoring chance and keep runners under control with solid defense. The Baseball 2003 brings Japanese professional baseball competition to GameCube.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Let it rip and take your Beyblade into the arena. Join the world of Beyblade V-Force, face rival bladers and fight to keep your spinning top in the battle. Choose your approach carefully as every clash brings another chance to outlast the competition and move closer to tournament victory.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Emperor Velo has dragged Crash and his rivals into a racing contest with far more at stake than a trophy. Tear around twisting courses, scoop up weapons and use power slides to stay ahead of the pack. Adventure races and competitive kart battles bring Crash's chaotic world back to the starting grid.
author: PRISM

synopsis: A Halloween outing turns into a rescue mission when two costumed friends discover that their companions have been turned to stone. Guide the young heroes through spooky surroundings, overcome platforming hazards and make use of their different abilities. A journey through the world of the dead is their friends' best hope of getting home.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Join Doraemon and his friends for a colorful adventure in Mini Doland. Explore a futuristic theme park, tackle playful action challenges and use handy items to get past the obstacles ahead. Familiar faces from Doraemon bring their world of unusual inventions and everyday friendship to a lighthearted GameCube outing.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Build your deck and enter the world of Duel Masters. Call powerful creatures into battle, support them with spells and look for the right moment to break through your opponent's defenses. Characters and events from the anime's first season give each duel a place in Shobu's card-battling adventure.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Test your strategy on the shogi board. Develop your pieces, watch for threats and turn captured pieces into fresh opportunities as you work toward checkmate. Eisei Meijin VI presents the traditional Japanese board game in a focused digital form, where careful planning matters more than quick reactions.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Bring your best baseball to the plate in this revised edition of Power Pro 11. Mix up your pitches, find a gap in the defense and keep the pressure on as the innings unfold. The series' compact, expressive players give its contest of batting, pitching and fielding a lively personality.
author: PRISM

synopsis: The water is rising, and your only way out is up. Catch falling puzzle pieces and assemble a tower sturdy enough to carry your egg-shaped builder toward safety. Fill the gaps, recover from mistakes and keep building as opponents and hazards threaten to turn a carefully stacked escape route into a scramble.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Leave MI6 behind and enter the dangerous world of Bond's villains. An expelled agent with a powerful artificial eye becomes caught in a struggle between criminal masterminds. Fight through first-person action encounters, combine weapons and use the GoldenEye's abilities to survive a campaign where loyalty is never guaranteed.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Team up with a Mamodo and its human partner for spell-powered battles from the world of Zatch Bell. Coordinate attacks and put each pair's abilities to work against rival teams. Full Power expands the earlier Yuujou Tag Battle with additional playable partnerships drawn from the series' first theatrical film.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Climb aboard for a railway rivalry across Japan. Roll the dice, race toward destinations and invest in properties while your opponents try to build fortunes of their own. Momotaro Dentetsu 12 adds a western Japan setting to the series' blend of travel, business decisions and unpredictable board-game events.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Enter a fantasy world where the fate of a nation depends on decisions made both on and off the battlefield. Guide your forces through strategic conflicts, manage the demands of war and explore the role-playing side of the adventure. Generation of Chaos Exceed combines army-level planning with character-focused journeys and dungeon exploration.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Travel Japan by rail and turn a little starting money into a business empire. Reach destinations, buy properties and use the luck of the dice to outmaneuver rival railway presidents. Profits can disappear as quickly as they arrive, especially when the troublesome Black Bonby joins this unpredictable board-game journey.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Return to the ballpark in the 2003 Memorial edition of Power Pro 10. Work the count, drive the ball into open space and shut down a rally with confident pitching and defense. This Chou Ketteiban release gives the series' bright, characterful baseball action another season on GameCube.
author: PRISM

synopsis: A new inning brings another chance to become the star of the diamond. Take control at the plate, on the mound and in the field as Power Pro's familiar cartoon baseball players compete for every run. Balance patience, timing and team play to turn a close game in your favor.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Join Croket and the colorful cast of the manga and anime for an action-filled adventure. Push through dangerous encounters and take on the challenge of saving the Bank King. Familiar characters and the series' larger-than-life style turn each confrontation into another test for its determined young hero.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Mario Kart heads to the arcade for a fast, item-filled racing challenge. Choose a familiar racer, dodge attacks and fight for position around colorful courses as the finish line approaches. Namco guests join Nintendo's cast in this Triforce arcade entry, bringing a different flavor to the series' competitive kart action.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Take a seat at the mahjong table and put your judgment to the test. Build a winning hand, read the discards and decide when an ambitious play is worth the risk. Kiwame Mahjong DX II brings traditional Japanese mahjong and its MONDO21 Cup competition theme to GameCube.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Spin the wheel and discover where life will take you. Guide a character from school into adulthood, choose a path through life's milestones and see how fortune changes along the way. This colorful adaptation of The Game of Life mixes board-game choices with friendly competition and occasional minigame challenges.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Stand with the Fellowship as the struggle for Middle-earth moves from desperate escapes to great battles. Fight as Aragorn, Legolas and Gimli through action stages inspired by the first two Lord of the Rings films. Learn new combat techniques, break through enemy ranks and face the growing power of Saruman's forces.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Mickey Mouse and friends have been invited to a park built for fun, and there's plenty of friendly rivalry waiting inside. Move around the game board, collect special items and jump into minigames and playful challenges. Disney's familiar characters turn a day at the park into a colorful party competition.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Bring manga-sized determination to the baseball diamond. Characters from Shinji Mizushima's baseball stories face professional players in a contest of pitching, batting and fielding. Pick your side, look for the decisive opening and see whether fictional all-stars or the professionals can come out on top.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Take a quieter journey along the pilgrimage routes of Shikoku. Visit temples represented from the historic Ohenro trail, offer prayers and collect seals as a record of your travels. Ohenro-San turns the atmosphere and customs of a Japanese pilgrimage into an unusual, reflective virtual journey.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Luffy and the Straw Hat crew have been challenged to a Treasure Battle, and backing down isn't their style. Join the pirates for a lively contest built around characters from One Piece. Put the crew's distinctive personalities to work and take on rivals as the battle over their prized collection unfolds.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Step right up and help Cocoto rescue his fairy friend. Take aim at a collection of colorful shooting-gallery challenges, watch for surprises and sharpen your accuracy as the carnival grows more demanding. Arcade-style minigames and competitive play turn this strange funfair into a test of quick reactions and steady aim.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Pull on your team's colors and take control of the next big baseball game. Choose your pitches carefully, time your swings and keep the defense alert as Power Pro's cartoon players battle for every base. A strong inning can change everything, but staying ahead takes teamwork from the first pitch to the last out.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Take your place in Power Pro's bright, expressive world of baseball. Outsmart batters with well-placed pitches, punish mistakes at the plate and turn solid fielding into another chance to score. Behind the friendly-looking players is a contest of timing and tactics where one well-played inning can decide the game.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Football gets rough when the rulebook takes a back seat. Lead an international side into an exaggerated, hard-hitting version of the sport where tackles are fierce and every attack can turn into a spectacle. Keep the ball moving, challenge your rivals and power your way toward the next goal.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Bring unusual monsters into the spotlight in a game inspired by NHK's Tensai Bit-kun program. Shape your creature's appearance, develop it for competition and put your choices to the test in battles. Creative monster-making and strategic encounters give each new contender a personality of its own.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Spend some time in the gentle world of Mutsu. Follow a small aquatic companion through a colorful underwater kingdom and enjoy a slower-paced change from the usual race or battle. The playful virtual-pet setting invites you to discover a watery world filled with charming little creatures.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Two Disney-Pixar adventures share one collection. Put the Parr family's superpowers to work in The Incredibles, then dive into Finding Nemo for an underwater journey inspired by the film. Switch between superhero action and ocean exploration as familiar characters face the dangers standing between them and their families.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Two Disney-Pixar adventures share one collection. Put the Parr family's superpowers to work in The Incredibles, then dive into Finding Nemo for an underwater journey inspired by the film. Switch between superhero action and ocean exploration as familiar characters face the dangers standing between them and their families.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Set off on two very different cartoon adventures. Help SpongeBob and Patrick face the challenges of The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie, then join Tak in Tak 2: The Staff of Dreams. This collection pairs undersea comedy with a magical platforming journey through the world of dreams.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Set off on two very different cartoon adventures. Help SpongeBob and Patrick face the challenges of The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie, then join Tak in Tak 2: The Staff of Dreams. This collection pairs undersea comedy with a magical platforming journey through the world of dreams.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Bikini Bottom needs its heroes in two SpongeBob adventures. Join SpongeBob and Patrick on the film-inspired journey of The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie, then help SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy stop a robot invasion in Battle for Bikini Bottom. Explore familiar places, tackle platforming challenges and bring order back to a very unusual underwater town.
author: PRISM

synopsis: Enter the Octagon and find a fighting style that works for you. Combine punches and kicks with takedowns, grappling and submission attempts as UFC competitors battle for the finish. This Japanese release of UFC: Throwdown brings mixed martial arts competition to GameCube, where a match can change with one well-timed move.
author: PRISM

synopsis: A day at Universal Studios becomes an adventure of its own. Explore the park and take on attractions inspired by familiar films, with challenges drawing you into their worlds. Collect what you need, find your way around the grounds and make the most of a visit packed with movie-themed activities.
author: PRISM

synopsis: An ordinary movie fan becomes the star when Joe is pulled into a world of cinematic action. Battle through side-scrolling stages using slow motion, fast motion and zoom powers to turn each encounter into a heroic performance. Revival adds an easier Sweet difficulty to the original Viewtiful Joe adventure.
author: PRISM

synopsis: A young chimney sweep's life changes when she earns a place at Vara Noir, an academy that trains students in battle and magic. Follow her into a fantasy adventure of new companions, dangerous places and discoveries. Character interactions, dungeon exploration and equipment development shape a journey that reaches beyond the classroom.
author: PRISM
